experiment_d_train.diagnosis: Zero multi-step or multi-turn tool chaining examples exist in Experiment D.

critical_supervision_deficits: Deficit 1 (Sequential Chaining Absence): Not a single example across 4,600 historical training records demonstrates taking an observation from Web search and passing extracted values into Python code.

Deficit 2 (Turn-2 Anti-Tool Bias): 100% of Corpus 2 training examples supervised the assistant to generate natural language synthesis immediately upon seeing a tool observation, actively discouraging subsequent tool calls.
Deficit 3 (Template Repetition in Corpus 2): 55% of Corpus 2 consisted of repetitive variants of only 5 base fact queries, leading to rapid memorization and early validation plateauing.
Deficit 4 (Format Inconsistency): Synthetic training tool results used rigid markdown bullet cards with [SOURCE X] headings, whereas live tool outputs from DuckDuckGo are noisy unstructured text.
